def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize species labels (case, spaces, typos)
    fix = {
        'adelie': 'Adelie', 'adeile': 'Adelie', 'adelie ': 'Adelie',
        'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'gentto': 'Gentoo',
        'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap', 'chinstarp': 'Chinstrap',
    }
    s = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['species'] = s.str.lower().map(fix).fillna(s)
    # body_mass_g written as text with thousands separators
    df['body_mass_g'] = (df['body_mass_g'].astype(str)
                         .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
                         .str.strip())
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # invalid flipper lengths
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df[df['species'] == 'Adelie']
    g = d.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean().round(2)
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.dropna().items()}
